'''Spaeth''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnaught]] that was transporting [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]] to [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]]. Spaeth thanked Trommer for defending the ship from a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack.
